notes: This bank defines candidate questions and branching only.
It does not encode supplement recommendations, doses, or clinical diagnoses.
Questions may be added, removed, or rewritten during Phase 2 when evidence rules reveal missing or unnecessary data.
BASIC should remain as short as possible through conditional logic.
Phase 1D audit classifies many BASIC questions as rule-specific/on-demand to minimize questionnaire burden.
Expanded goal taxonomy supports general population and future thematic marketing entry points.
Final Phase 1 audit adds special-profile context questions for night/shift work, travel and mental demand.
